whitaker-disputation: William Whitaker, A Disputation on Holy Scripture against the Papists (Latin 1588; English, Parker Society, 1849)
statuta-ecclesiae-antiqua: Statuta Ecclesiae Antiqua (southern Gaul, late 400s AD), once called the canons of a "Fourth Council of Carthage"
bcp-1549: The Book of Common Prayer (1549), "The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony"
augustine-good-marriage: Augustine, On the Good of Marriage (De bono coniugali), AD 401
porten-elephantine: Bezalel Porten et al., The Elephantine Papyri in English: Three Millennia of Cross-Cultural Continuity and Change (1996)
hoekema-bible-future: Anthony A. Hoekema, The Bible and the Future (1979)
mishnah-ketubot: Mishnah, tractate Ketubot ("Marriage Contracts"), compiled about AD 200
haydock-commentary: George Leo Haydock, Haydock's Catholic Bible Commentary (1859 edition), notes on Tobit 5, gathering Challoner, Calmet, Menochius and others
